summary: The wizard accepts the force prompt for an aligned cleric, so read.c:create_particular_creation() calls makemon() for PM_ALIGNED_CLERIC without MM_EPRI or MM_EMIN. C makemon.c:makemon() then creates EMIN data, marks the monster as a minion, draws its minion alignment and renegade state, sets peacefulness, and calls set_malign(). The corresponding special initialization arm is missing from js/makemon_create.js:makemon(), so the first random call and the appearance text diverge at step 27. The earliest source owner is makemon.c:makemon(); the later chat behavior is downstream of this creation state.

source.branch: The recorded ^G request is “peaceful aligned cleric”; create_particular_creation() accepts y to override the human-zombie substitute and restores PM_ALIGNED_CLERIC. It calls makemon() with NO_MM_FLAGS plus MM_NOEXCLAM, so MM_EPRI and MM_EMIN are both absent. makemon() takes the PM_ALIGNED_CLERIC/PM_HIGH_CLERIC arm of its special extended-data condition: newemin(), isminion = 1, min_align = rn2(3) - 1, renegade = (MM_ANGRY ? 1 : !rn2(3)), peacefulness derived from min_align versus hero alignment and renegade, then set_malign(). The source’s alternate angel condition and its random check remain part of the whole makemon() function.
callers: nethack-c/upstream/src/cmd.c:1961-1962 dispatches Ctrl-G to wizcmds.c:wiz_genesis(); js/cmd.js dispatches wiz_genesis to js/wizcmds.js:wiz_genesis().
nethack-c/upstream/src/wizcmds.c:203-210 calls read.c:create_particular(); js/wizcmds.js:225-231 calls js/read.js:create_particular().

nethack-c/upstream/src/read.c:3252-3371 implements create_particular_creation(): lines 3260-3273 accept the force answer and lines 3315 onward call makemon(whichpm, u.ux, u.uy, mmflags). js/read.js:1486-1562 mirrors the selection and calls makemon_runtime() at 1529-1532, whose constructor path reaches js/makemon_create.js:makemon().
dependencies: The missing arm calls minion.c:newemin() to allocate mextra.emin, then writes monster.isminion, mextra.emin.min_align, mextra.emin.renegade, and monster.mpeaceful before makemon.c:set_malign(). JS already has newemin() in js/minion.js and set_malign() in js/makemon.js; the gap is the source-ordered branch and its two rn2(3) draws in js/makemon_create.js:makemon(). Preserve the prior peace_minded() result only until this branch overwrites it, then let set_malign() read the new minion state.

evidence: The saved queue entry for synthetic/v7/priest-outside-temple-chat identifies 2 remaining screens and 35 recorded steps. challenges/evaluations/20260926122253-v7.json, evaluated at f7e48bd93d6827c557c9a40a255a55cbc5fc8fcf, reports 33/35 screens matched; its first mismatch is segment 0 step 27 on key y. C and JS differ at row 0, column 9, and the first RNG mismatch is C rn2(3)=1 at makemon.c:1423 versus JS rnd(2)=1 at the same recorded step.

The C recording challenges/cases/v7/priest-outside-temple-chat.session.json shows step 26 asking “Creating human zombie instead; force aligned cleric? [yn] (n)”; step 27 answers y and C displays “A priest of Thoth appears next to you.” Its RNG trace calls rn2(3)=1 at makemon.c:1423 for min_align and rn2(3)=1 at makemon.c:1424 for renegade before inventory setup.

Upstream makemon.c:1410-1429 initializes EMIN data for PM_ALIGNED_CLERIC or PM_HIGH_CLERIC when neither MM_EPRI nor MM_EMIN was supplied, marks the monster as a minion, sets min_align/renegade/peacefulness in that order, then calls set_malign(). In JS, makemon_create.js:3075 only allocates EMIN when MM_EMIN is already present; its later default peacefulness path is followed by set_malign() without the aligned-cleric source arm. js/minion.js:newemin() and js/makemon.js:set_malign() provide the state helpers, but the producing branch and its draws are missing.

Production reachability is cmd.c Ctrl-G -> wiz_genesis() -> read.c:create_particular() -> create_particular_creation() -> makemon(); JS wires the same path through cmd.js, wizcmds.js, read.js, and makemon_create.js:makemon_runtime(). Thus the first mismatch is during source-owned monster creation at makemon.c:1423, before any later chat behavior is an actionable owner for this case.
